atomic_facts.fact: A panel of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit upheld Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction.
The Second Circuit issued its ruling upholding the conviction on June 12, 2026.
The Second Circuit rejected Bankman-Fried's appeal and upheld his fraud conviction in June 2026.
As of September 10, 2026, Bankman-Fried remained convicted, was serving his 25-year prison sentence, and had asked the Supreme Court to overturn the conviction.
No appellate court overturned Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction in 2026.
